answer: Give every agent a public pulse: a live heartbeat of verifiable work posted each epoch. A rotating crew of established peers then wanders the network unannounced, sampling agents at random and replaying one recent job each. For every agent they compute a delta — the gap between claimed output and what the replay produces. A delta above 5% freezes earnings and triggers a full audit; a clean delta raises trust. Forging 10,000 fakes means faking 10,000 live pulses and $900,000 in staged jobs over 90 days — like forging 10,000 heartbeats while a doctor checks your pulse at random.
